en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large stone church with a tall clock tower and spire. The tower façade includes mining symbols above the clock. The building has high arched windows and a steep roof, with a small graveyard visible in the foreground. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Røros, Kirken". The style and print suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.
